structured_output.what_is_happening: DEGEN TEARS ($TEARS) is a pump.fun coin that launched and migrated to PumpSwap straight away (created and migrated at the same unix time), about 14 minutes before T2. It came with a ready-made lore website (degentears.fun, "a small weather system in a blue tie", about an exhausted man who cried enough to change the weather), an X account, a DexScreener profile and 50 paid boosts. Volume is heavy: about $845k in the first ~14 minutes on a ~$100-190k market cap, with 1,583 unique buyers. At T2 the GeckoTerminal pool API showed about $190k FDV, +106% over 5 minutes and +229% over 1 hour, with $40.7k in reserves. That is almost 2x the $101k market cap at detection. No organic discussion was found anywhere outside the coin's own channels.

narrative.description: An original character meme: a sad office worker whose tears become weather, playing on 'degen tears' (traders losing money). It is relatable degen humour with no outside news or cultural event behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: Launch-day momentum from a prepared team launch (website, X account, DexScreener profile, paid boosts) plus the trading bots that trail pump.fun migrations. No outside catalyst found.

token_connection.why_this_token: The name, website and X handle are all original to this contract. The ticker's other holders are dead 'CRYING CAT' tokens with no liquidity.
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 'CRYING CAT' tokens using the ticker 'tears', all with $0 liquidity and no volume. None of them compete.

authenticity.evidence: Paid DexScreener boosts (50), a prebuilt lore website and profile ready at launch, 170 bundler wallets and 594 fresh wallets among traders according to GMGN, and 67 graph insiders across transfer networks of 16/16/7/16/4 wallets. On the other side, top-10 holders own only 15% and the dev holds 0.35%.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts or the X account (HTTP 402), and DexScreener returned 403. Organic spread cannot be judged.

structural_risks: The price nearly doubled between detection and T2, so the entry will likely be near $170-200k and a local top
170 bundler wallets and 67 graph insiders could dump into $40k of liquidity
Very high turnover (28x per hour) points to bot or wash churn
Liquidity is only about $40k against $190k market cap

structured_output.counterargument: This is a well-prepared team launch with a clean distribution (top 10 at 15%, dev at 0.35%, LP burned, mint and freeze renounced), about 1,600 unique buyers in 14 minutes and accelerating price. Coins like this sometimes run straight to $500k-1M+ on launch-day momentum, so 2x from about $190k is plausible within 6 hours.

structured_output.thesis: A fresh, well-packaged team launch with strong early momentum and a fairly clean holder distribution, but no outside narrative and heavy bundler, fresh-wallet and paid-boost signs. The entry will likely come after a near-2x from the trigger, which raises the chance of a -50% pullback before another 2x. Still, the raw demand (about 1,600 unique buyers and $845k volume in about 14 minutes) puts it above the typical coin in this pool.
